# Source indexes and rendering metadata

These JSON files support the Atlas's source browsing and paper reading pages.
The [dataset reference](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#use-the-data) explains their
fields, producers and limits.

The [website and map are agent-navigable](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/agents.md).
Start with [llms.txt](https://wcook04.github.io/plectis-atlas/llms.txt) for public
entry points and instructions for traversing the existing map JSON.

- `families.json`, `manuscripts.json` and `statements.json` index the pinned release.
- `graph.json` and `works.json` record citations within and outside it.
- `summary.json` contains baseline extraction counts. The website's evidence
  counts and membership records come from the separate [backend export](../backend/EXPORT.json).
- `paper_acceptance.json`, `statement_numbers.json` and `paper_labels.json`
  describe the paper renderer's output, including conversion limits and labels.
- `lean_claims.json` and `lean_xref.json` index Lean declarations and source links.

JSON changes belong in the producing scripts, followed by regeneration.
Start with [source ownership](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#where-responsibilities-live)
before refreshing an index or changing the upstream pin. To update this folder
guide, edit `scripts/sync_readme.py` and run it from the repository root.
